Marketing Intern

Mwangaza Logistics
Industrial Area, Nairobi

Mwangaza Logistics is offering a six-month marketing internship for a recent graduate based at our Industrial Area depot. The intern will support campaign scheduling, draft social captions, and compile weekly performance reports for the marketing lead.

This is an internship and industrial attachment friendly placement. Candidates with no experience are welcome; we will train on our tools. A stipend of KSh 20,000 per month is provided, plus transport within Nairobi.

Deadline for applications: 30 November 2026. Send your application to internships@mwangazalogistics.co.ke with the subject line Marketing Intern.
